in_sanskrit.name: Budhil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Intellectual, Knowledgeable
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Budhil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Buddhi', meaning intellect or knowledge. This name is given to honor the wisdom and intelligence of the child.

in_hindi.name: Budhil
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Intellectual, Knowledgeable
in_hindi.long_meaning: Budhil एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Buddhi', meaning intellect or knowledge. This name is given to honor the wisdom and intelligence of the child.

in_tamil.name: Budhil
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Intellectual, Knowledgeable
in_tamil.long_meaning: Budhil ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Buddhi', meaning intellect or knowledge. This name is given to honor the wisdom and intelligence of the child.

in_telugu.name: Budhil
in_telugu.long_meaning: Budhil ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Buddhi', meaning intellect or knowledge. This name is given to honor the wisdom and intelligence of the child.

in_marathi.name: Budhil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Budhil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Buddhi', meaning intellect or knowledge. This name is given to honor the wisdom and intelligence of the child.

in_bengali.name: Budhil
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Intellectual, Knowledgeable
in_bengali.long_meaning: Budhil একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Buddhi', meaning intellect or knowledge. This name is given to honor the wisdom and intelligence of the child.
